R-20.description: Single Family Residential, Low Density. 20,000 sq ft minimum lot. 1.3-2.2 du/net ac.

R-15.description: Single Family Residential, Low Density. 15,000 sq ft minimum lot. 1.3-3.0 du/net ac.

R-10.description: Single Family Residential, Medium Density. 10,000 sq ft minimum lot. 3.1-4.5 du/net ac.

R-10A.description: Single Family Residential, Medium Density (Alternate). 10,000 sq ft minimum lot. 3.1-4.5 du/net ac.

R-7.description: Single Family Residential, High Density. 7,000 sq ft minimum lot. 4.6-6.2 du/net ac.

R-6.description: Single Family Residential, High Density. 6,000 sq ft minimum lot. 4.6-7.3 du/net ac.

MRVL.description: Very Low Density Multiple-Family Residential. Duplexes, townhomes. 7-11.9 du/ac.

MRL.description: Low Density Multiple-Family Residential. Townhomes, small apartments. 12-19.9 du/ac.

MRM.description: Medium Density Multiple-Family Residential. Apartments, condominiums. 20-29.9 du/ac.

MRH.description: High Density Multiple-Family Residential. Apartments, condominiums, townhouses. 30-40 du/ac.

MRVH.description: Very High Density Multiple-Family Residential. Intensive multifamily including studio flats, condominiums, apartments. 40-73 du/ac.

MX-N.description: Neighborhood Mixed-Use District. Residential above or behind ground floor neighborhood-serving commercial.

MX-C.description: Community Mixed-Use District. Residential above ground floor commercial in community centers.

C.description: General Commercial District. Retail, office, and service commercial uses.

NB.description: Neighborhood Business District. Small-scale neighborhood retail and service uses.

O.description: Office District. Professional office and administrative uses.

LI.description: Limited Industrial District. Light industrial, warehousing, and manufacturing uses.

PUD.description: Planned Unit Development District. Density varies per underlying general plan designation and approved plan.

R6.description: Single Family Residential, High Density (alternate code for R-6). 6,000 sq ft minimum lot. 4.6-7.3 du/net ac.

R7.description: Single Family Residential, High Density (alternate code for R-7). 7,000 sq ft minimum lot. 4.6-6.2 du/net ac.

R10.description: Single Family Residential, Medium Density (alternate code for R-10). 10,000 sq ft minimum lot. 3.1-4.5 du/net ac.

R10A.description: Single Family Residential, Medium Density Alternate (alternate code for R-10A). 10,000 sq ft minimum lot. 3.1-4.5 du/net ac.

R15.description: Single Family Residential, Low Density (alternate code for R-15). 15,000 sq ft minimum lot. 1.3-3.0 du/net ac.

R20.description: Single Family Residential, Low Density (alternate code for R-20). 20,000 sq ft minimum lot. 1.3-2.2 du/net ac.

RB.description: Retail Business District. General retail and commercial uses.

HPUD.description: Housing Planned Unit Development. Residential PUD with density per approved plan.

PAO.description: Professional and Administrative Office District. Office and professional uses.

PPD.description: Precise Plan Development District. Density per approved precise plan.

PUD-H.description: Planned Unit Development - Housing. Residential PUD, density per approved plan.
